name: @curdx/flow
description: Interactive installer for Claude Code plugins and MCP servers

scripts.test:hooks: npm run build:hooks && vitest run tests/hooks --passWithNoTests
scripts.test:claudecc:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:hooks && node scripts/claudecc-e2e-flow.mjs
scripts.test:claudecc:e2e:suite: npm run build && npm run build:hooks && node scripts/claudecc-e2e-suite.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:evidence && npm run test:state && npm run test:verdict && npm run test:reports && npm run test:policy && npm run test:capabilities && npm run test:planner && npm run test:browser && npm run test:api && npm run test:data && npm run test:fullstack && npm run test:discovery && npm run test:services && npm run test:readiness && npm run test:recovery && npm run test:release && npm run check-versions && npm run check:hooks-fresh && npm run build && npm run check:bundle && npm run test:hooks && npm run test:analyze && npm run test:runner && node scripts/check-verification-blocks.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: node scripts/check-versions.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run check:hooks-fresh && npm run build
